summary: Query alltrails.com (trail search, trail detail, reviews, photos, weather, and a signed-in user's saved lists / completed trails / activity feed) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the alltrails-mcp server — one-shot calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want AllTrails data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
